profile.headline: Embedded Engineer | Smart home systems | Cameras
profile.summary:
I have been working with Embedded systems since 2014. My earlier career focused on Embedded Linux resulted in a lot of exposure to a very broad range of Linux development from low level designs in the platform such as kernel drivers development to middleware applications before taking a small break in 2018. 

I was then pursuing higher education in Electrical and Computer Engineering at University of Utah and found myself a chance to hone my skills with embedded systems again after a few semesters. In early 2019 I joined  Professor Pierre Emmanuel Gaillardon at University of Utah as a researcher working on a novel Cloud based air quality sensor platform which has now become TELLUS networked sensors solution.

Since May 2020, I have been employed by Prodatakey and Goal Zero to work on different embedded systems about Cloud based access control and IoT backup power systems respectively which caught me up with a lot of new technologies on modern embedded systems ranging from system designs to Cloud backend best practices. During the years, I have had a lot of opportunities to work with great talents who have influenced me a lot in both personal and career growth.

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Sr. Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed a scalable OTA solution for Goal Zero's flagship solar generator and products in the ecosystem.
- Designed, developed and managed the automated warehouse update.
- Lead development in OTA, cooperate with manufacturing contractors to deploy the OTA solution to other products in Goal zero's ecosystem.
- Managed Over-the-air update, test, rollout and maintenance.
- Devops: contributed, designed and developed a scalable CI/CD workflow to automate the build process and firmware release deployment to AWS for multiple products on different environments.
- Managed warehouse update reports. Designed tool to help getting reports from AWS DynamoDB.
- Troubleshoot cloud connectivities from device log and AWS Cloudwatch, IoT core.

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
- Develop Primary Controller Firmware for next gen solar generator
- Modbus protocol
- Architected, Developed a scalable, portable Bootloader solution for system update
- Developed OTA controller

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
-    Architected/developed firmware for a Tester/Provisioner for hardware mass production/verification/provision, which is compatible with all the flagship PDK Red access controllers: Architecture skill, bootloader, C++, multithreaded application, UART, I2C, RS485, Circuit design, JavaScript, JSON, Raspberry Pi configuration, Linux scripting language, SSH.
-    Developed new features/Maintenance PDK Red controller (https://www.prodatakey.com/red2) in a Cloud Based Access Control System: C++17, FreeRTOS, Arm Cortex M4, Bootloader, Device Driver, Flash File System, Hardware Debug, TCP/IP, Json, Xbee, OTA firmware update
-    Developed driver/application for secure boot using a Secure Element from Microchip: Elliptic Curve Cryptography, I2C, C++, Python
-    Designed/Developed firmware for Power Management IC from Texas Instrument for managing power characteristics as well as charge controller: C++, Moving average, Power management features, Battery Charging.
-    Integrated 3rd party OSDP library. Developed/maintenance PDK OSDP application.
-    Card reader technologies: Wiegand, OSDP
-    Along with other tasks: troubleshooting, board bring up, schematic verification, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Bootloader · Embedded Software · Embedded C++ · Embedded Devices · GNU Debugger · FreeRTOS · Python (Programming Language) · REST APIs · Linux · Access Control · Device Drivers

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Help on a research to collect air pollutant data from all over the valley. The job including:
- Develop Embedded application on ESP32, which based on FreeRTOS to collect data
- Set up sensors infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform
- Develop Application that help in fabricating as well as interfacing which the DB infrastructure
